description: Preserve Self-EvolveRec’s diagnostic interface while adapting its probes to the actual GRU4Rec model. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns measured metrics and explicit metric_definitions. diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis) converts these results into an evidence-based interpretation prompt.
motivation: Architecture-aware diagnostics can identify weaknesses in sequential recommendation without relying on unavailable reviews, ratings, product attributes, or simulated user traits. Model selection remains grounded in macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets.
implementation_notes: Retain the host ModelView interfaces: model, item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Consume batches shaped B x L as (None, sequence, positive, negative), exclude padding from measurements, and use the final nonpadding position for left-padded sequence readout. Report unavailable signals as unavailable. Preserve five real training users per category for full-catalog unseen-item recommendations. Keep one independently trained GRU4Rec model per category, dataset routing, and checkpoint/predictor consistency. Diagnostics must not access hidden test data or replace the pinned validation evaluator.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device): retain actual model and compatibility interfaces
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state; enter evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
                compute features through view.log2feats(sequence)
                score items through view.predict_score(features, items)
                accumulate applicable measurements over valid positions
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_results, metric_definitions: definitions}

def diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics, definitions, and missing-signal limitations
    request evidence-supported GRU4Rec improvement hypotheses
    preserve single-model and fixed-evaluation constraints

originality.positive: Makes diagnostic interpretation explicitly aware of model-family interfaces and observable data.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm; score uses a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Could support targeted architecture and training improvements through repeatable, interpretable measurements.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic usefulness and resulting HR@10 gains require experimental validation.

code_difficulty.positive: The fixed adapter interfaces and batch format provide a clear implementation boundary.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding, feature alignment, metric aggregation, and architecture compatibility require care; higher scores indicate greater difficulty.
